description: A-HARDENING correctness-hardening allow-list (ENG-2478, Architecture twQ3BBzpTE section 2). The 18 items below are the fork's correctness fixes to upstream behaviour — the first 15 are the architecture-named set; items 16-18 are the post-activation null-userAtom client guards admitted under ENG-3287 (see their own descriptions), and the architecture page still says 15, a drift recorded on that ticket rather than left silent. Each item is tagged with its REAL, currently-resolvable anchor (file + a marker string the file must contain) so ENG-2477's FR-30 divergence gate recognises them as permitted divergence rather than un-permitted drift, and so an upstream tag bump that breaks an anchor fails ledger validation LOUDLY naming the item. Distinct from patches/inline-edit-allowlist.json (ENG-1649 context-drift subsystem) and from fr30/allowlist.json's own 13-row allow-list class. Cosmetics (Swagger tags, log-level tuning, micro-fixes) are a NAMED, NOT-applied class recorded in docs/runbooks/overlay-rebase-import.md — never re-applied on import, never listed here.

items.name: ifVersion CAS

anchor.contains: the pure domain guard for the `ifVersion` CAS precondition

items.description: Compare-and-set precondition on page writes: a stale ifVersion is a 409, never a silent lost update (ENG-1413).

items.name: unique-slug retry

anchor.contains: a keyless retry with byte-identical `replace` content is a true no-op

items.description: Retry determinism against the page's unique slug/title identity: the three-tier upsert lookup (slugId -> externalId -> (spaceId,parentPageId,title)) makes a retried create/upsert land on the same page instead of minting a duplicate. Anchor mapping note: no standalone slug-retry loop exists at HEAD; this three-tier idempotent lookup IS the mechanism that makes slug-keyed retries safe.

items.name: copy-title dedup
items.description: Duplicate-page copy titles bump a ' (N)' suffix (pre-flight pick + bounded 23505 retry loop) instead of colliding (ENG-1471).

items.name: move-cycle guard

anchor.contains: cycle guard: the recursive CTE walks down from the moved

items.description: movePage refuses to re-parent a page under its own descendants — the recursive CTE guard prevents corrupting the tree into a cycle.

items.name: attachment-copy resilience
items.description: Duplicating a page survives an individual attachment-copy failure (logged, not fatal) instead of aborting the whole duplicate.

items.name: unique-title-per-parent index
items.description: The CLI idempotency invariant: a partial unique index (NULLS NOT DISTINCT) makes page create/upsert by title under a parent deterministic, so the Orvex CLI/wiki-api can retry safely (ENG-1471).

items.name: real-IP handling
items.description: trustProxy + fastify-ip + the onRequest raw-ip hook: the client's real IP is resolved behind the proxy chain and threaded to consumers (throttling, audit).

items.name: user-throttler key fix
items.description: Throttle tracker keys on the authenticated user (falling back to IP), so one tenant's traffic cannot exhaust another's rate budget.

items.name: authMethod classification
items.description: 'api_key' vs human-session caller classification, threaded by JwtStrategy and read via the AuthMethod param decorator (ENG-1447 AC5).

items.name: attachment delete-authz
items.description: Attachment/icon removal is CASL-ability-guarded (workspace + space ability checks) — deletion is authorized, never an unauthenticated side effect.

items.name: filename sanitising
items.description: Uploaded filenames are sanitised (and length-bounded at the attachment chokepoint) before touching storage paths.

items.name: postgres-URL normaliser
items.description: DATABASE_URL is normalised (scheme/param quirks) before the driver consumes it — boot-migrate and runtime share one URL interpretation.

items.name: streaming-response bypass
items.description: The @SkipTransform bypass in the global response interceptor: streaming/raw endpoints (file downloads, exports, health) skip the JSON envelope instead of being buffered/corrupted.

items.name: FK/query-path index migrations
items.description: Query-path index hardening: the api-key hash lookup index is the anchored representative of the fork's added FK/query-path indexes (each shipped in its own migration).

items.name: slug-rewrite-on-title-change
items.description: A title change enqueues an in-place rewrite of referring ProseMirror link nodes (ENG-1398), exercised by the testcontainers-backed slug-rewrite.task.spec.ts.

items.name: null-user settings guard (page width)

anchor.contains: The optional chain has to start at `user`

items.description: userAtom is null until the user query resolves, so `user.settings?...` — optional-chaining the second hop but not the first — threw an UNCAUGHT 'Cannot read properties of null' on a cold load of /settings/account/preferences, which unmounted the React tree and left #root empty: a total white screen. Observed live before the fix (body text length 0) and after (renders). ENG-3287.
